title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.
body: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.
summaryZh: OpenAI首席财务官Sarah Friar阐述了芯片、算力、模型和产品之间的协同进展。这些技术突破共同推动了更大规模、更高实用性且更低成本的智能服务普及。
